info.name: Inflammatix Support & Training Content API (WordPress REST)

description.content:
The public, anonymously-readable content API exposed by support.inflammatix.com - the Inflammatix customer support and TriVerity/Myrna operator-training portal. Alongside the standard WordPress content collections it exposes the MemberPress Courses post types (`mpcs-course`, `mpcs-lesson`, `mpcs-quiz`) that back the Myrna and TriVerity training curriculum, so the course catalogue is machine-readable even though lesson bodies sit behind the customer login. DERIVED mechanically from the provider's own route-discovery document: every path, method, and parameter below is copied verbatim from https://support.inflammatix.com/wp-json/ . Write operations exist on the live host but require authentication and are deliberately not modelled here.

Contact Support:
 Name: Inflammatix
